claim: *Incrementally extending the alignment kernel.* The kernel contains the modeled properties that must already be protected while active alignment changes the system. Additional models extend the governed surface, but each new alignment operates subject to the constraints established by the models already in the kernel. The layers are not different classes of model; they show models such as those introduced in Chapter 2 becoming governing constraints over time.
topology: Four nested governing layers remain concentric, with initial kernel M_A at the center and M_B, M_C, M_D progressing outward. The numbered four-step sequence remains a separate action progression, now to the left of the circles: identify kernel, actively align, extend, repeat. The layers are not model classes and are not equated with the numbered steps.
bw_encoding: Concentric layers use 3%, 7%, 11% and 16% gray, lightest outside and darkest in the initial kernel, imitating the original’s single green family. Containment and M_A–M_D labels carry the meaning independently of tone. Step circles use 8% gray and remain numbered 1–4 with directed progression.
redesign: Review candidate addressing author feedback: distinguish numbered actions 1–4 from models M_A–M_D; restore light, progressively darker inward shading; bring each number next to its action and place the compact action list to the left of the bullseye. Remove the poorly arranged bottom annotation because its protected-region and admission claims are already explained in the unchanged caption and adjacent kernel discussion. Preserve every existing step phrase, nested-circle meaning and 10pt prose. The ellipsis is removed. A separate contextual proof uses the actual section prose and caption in the house template, with the figure beside prose at 56.5% of the text width; final chapter integration remains untested.
